title: 第6章 感谢老铁救我狗命！-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》
content:
第(1/3)页

    起初他以为是夜风骤降，但紧接着，他绝望地发现，自己浑身上下的汗毛正一根根倒竖起来，冷汗瞬间浸透了脊背！

    蓝星上那些无聊的短视频科普突然在脑海中炸回荡：

    半夜突然惊醒，若是周围毫无异常，千万别动，继续装睡，那多半是家里进人了。

    在这片吃人的荒原，这个时间段，进的绝对不会是人！

    许默死死屏住呼吸，眼角余光疯狂扫视着篝火摇曳的阴影。

    周围什么都没有。

    就在他以为神经紧绷出现错觉的刹那。

    吼——！！！

    一声震耳欲聋的恐怖兽吼从远处的黑暗深处轰然炸响，连带着身下的土地都隐隐发颤！

    许默瞳孔骤缩！

    蜂后！有情况！

    他在脑海中疯狂催动精神指令，试图联系那只虫子。

    毫无回应。

    一片死寂。

    许默愣了一瞬，视线猛地扫向属性面板。

    【蜂蜜花酿】附加的“触角”状态图标，赫然已经灰暗！

    八小时的有效时间，竟然在沉睡中悄无声息地耗尽了！

    该死。

    许默咬紧牙关，手忙脚乱地抓起石斧，蹑手蹑脚地缩进山窝最深处的岩石夹角。

    黑暗中仿佛有无数双眼睛在窥视，草丛里窸窸窣窣的声音像附骨之疽般萦绕不散。

    幽蓝色的光幕突然亮起。

    区域聊天频道正在疯狂滚动。

    【编号8847231：听见没？！刚才那声吼！草！我感觉它就在我避难所外边转悠！】

    【编号1234901：救命啊……我的篝火快灭了，我不敢出去捡柴！理智快掉光了！】

    【编号9902341：这到底是个什么世界啊，我要回家，我不想死了……】

    许默盯着屏幕，喉结微动，迅速在光屏上敲击。

    【许默：兽吼距离很远，别自己吓自己，看好火把别出声。】

    发出这行字，许默将后脑勺紧紧贴着冰冷的岩壁。

    那吼声确实远，他这里暂时还算安全，可周遭那若有若无的诡异动静从未停歇，那种如芒在背的恐怖感死死攥着他的心脏。

    漫长的煎熬中，第一缕微光终于撕裂了厚重的黑幕。

    天亮了。

    公屏里的哀嚎声非但没有减弱，反而越发绝望。

    一夜未眠，加上极度的恐惧，无数人的理智值已经逼近红线。

    许默不知道理智值一旦清零，迎接他们的会是怎样恐怖的下场。

    他扫向系统顶端的刺眼数据。

    【当前区域编号：9527幸存人数：2213】

    昨天还是三千多！

    仅仅是第二个夜晚，又没了一千多人！
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At first, he thought it was the sudden drop in the night wind, but then, he desperately found that the hairs all over his body were standing on end, and cold sweat instantly soaked his back!

Those boring short popular science videos on Blue Star suddenly echoed in my mind:

If you suddenly wake up in the middle of the night, if there is nothing unusual around you, don't move and continue to pretend to be asleep. It's probably because someone has entered the house.

In this man-eating wasteland, at this time, the person who enters will definitely not be a human being!

Xu Mo held his breath and frantically scanned the swaying shadow of the bonfire with the corner of his eye.

There is nothing around.

Just when he thought his nerves were tense and he was experiencing an illusion.

Roar——!!!

A deafening roar of a terrifying beast exploded from the depths of darkness in the distance, causing the ground beneath him to tremble faintly!

Xu Mo’s pupils shrank suddenly!

Queen bee!There is a situation!

He frantically activated mental commands in his mind, trying to contact the insect.

No response.

There was dead silence.

Xu Mo was stunned for a moment, and his eyes suddenly glanced at the attribute panel.

【Honey Flower Brew】The additional "tentacles" status icon is suddenly gray!

The effective time of eight hours was quietly exhausted while sleeping!

Damn it.

Xu Mo gritted his teeth, hurriedly grabbed the stone ax, and crept into the corner of the deepest rock in the nest.

There seemed to be countless pairs of eyes peeping in the darkness, and the rustling sounds in the grass lingered like gangrene in the bones.

A faint blue light curtain suddenly lit up.

The regional chat channel is scrolling like crazy.

【No. 8847231: Did you hear it?!That roar just now!Grass!I feel like it's hanging around outside my shelter!】

【No. 1234901: Help... My bonfire is almost out, I dare not go out to collect firewood!My sanity is almost gone!】

【Number 9902341: What kind of world is this? I want to go home, I don’t want to die...】

Xu Mo stared at the screen, his Adam's apple moved slightly, and he quickly tapped on the light screen.

【Xu Mo: The roar of the beast is far away, don't scare yourself, watch the torch and don't make any sound.】

After saying these words, Xu Mo pressed the back of his head against the cold rock wall.

The roar was indeed far away, and he was still safe here for the time being, but the vague and strange movements around him never stopped, and the sense of terror like a ray of light on his back gripped his heart.

After a long period of suffering, the first glimmer of light finally tore through the thick black curtain.

It’s dawn.

The wailing in the public screen not only did not weaken, but became more desperate.

After a sleepless night and extreme fear, the sanity of countless people has approached the red line.

Xu Mo didn’t know what kind of horrific end would happen to them once their sanity was cleared.

He glanced at the dazzling data at the top of the system.

【Current area number: 9527 Number of survivors: 2213】

Yesterday it was more than three thousand!

It was only the second night, and more than a thousand people were gone!
